notes.title: Battle Train is rolling into the station with an explosive new update!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066558/187989c741174fd852ea81a2d3b2e0a23e9fff4d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hi all! [/p][p][/p][p]We’re super excited to tell you all about the giant mega update coming to Battle Train on September 4th.  It’s basically two updates in one, both with substantial new stuff, along with a couple fixes to some bugs reported by the community (thank you!)[/p][p][/p][p]First, we’ve got ENDLESS MODE!!!  Endless Mode is just what it sounds like: as long as you survive, you can keep crushing your enemies.  Here’s what you’ll be seeing in game:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]A new submenu for the “play” button, to keep the main menu nice and uncluttered[/p][/*][*][p]The Endless Overworld, balanced to make opponents more difficult as you hit each subsequent map[/p][/*][*][p]Additional map boards for minigames, to keep things from getting repetitive for those super long survival runs[/p][/*][*][p]An Endless Mode Leaderboard, because honestly, it’s all about bragging rights, isn’t it?[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As for bug fixes, we’ve addressed the following:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Your display name should now fit on the leaderboard[/p][/*][*][p]Each train part slot should now only have ONE part assigned to it for the daily run[/p][/*][*][p]Your incredibly long, high damage locomotives should be able to finish hitting your target without   timing out now, which was causing catastrophic mayhem (to turn progression, as well as to the   enemy outpost).[/p][/*][*][p]Run durations should now properly reset, which was previously leading to a series of issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Cards should show consistently as the correct type[/p][/*][*][p]And some translation corrections[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Then, as if that wasn’t enough, we are also releasing our first DLC, [i]Revenge of the Puffin[/i]!  Do you love the Battle Train story?  Do you want… [i]more?  [/i]How about more opponents, more puzzles, and more maps?  Well, friend, we have got you covered!  [i]Revenge of the Puffin [/i]includes:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]A new chapter of the Battle Train story[/p][/*][*][p]A new custom Overworld, where player progression is saved, and players can take multiple runs at challenging bosses or puzzle levels.[/p][/*][*][p]A new champion and new grunts[/p][/*][*][p]New cards, trains, stickers, and hats![/p][/*][*][p]New custom maps, designed to provoke your problem solving skills[/p][/*][*][p]New custom Explodathon puzzles[/p][/*][*][p]A new Snowy Environment[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Frankly, we cannot wait to see how you all like it.  We think it’s pretty darn neat.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066558/ab40d5f8edc0e4cc2322e75941898c9df394a1cd.png"][/img]Battle Train Endless Mode Update and Revenge of the Puffin DLC will be available on Steam on September 4th, and Switch on September 5th.[/p]

notes.title: We’ve got a Hotfix for you!!!
notes.content: [p][/p][p]Hello, Battle Train players! [/p][p][/p][p]First and foremost, we’d like to thank every single one of you who has played Battle Train and reached out to us with your feedback. Your positive comments mean the world to us, and your constructive criticism helps us make the game better![/p][p][/p][p]On that second point, we’ve got some updates we think you’ll be excited to see.[/p][p][/p][p]●       We’ve updated the way we are tracking Door of Worthiness progress, as well as the frequency of story nodes, to address feedback from you all–progression should be much, much faster and players shouldn’t feel as penalized for not choosing story paths now, which helps with some (although not all) of the story-gate feedback we’ve received[/p][p]●       You can now rebind the keyboard’s directional keys for camera movement/card selection[/p][p]●       We’ve made it more obvious when the player has a connected route and can attack, so that players are less likely to accidentally end their turn without attacking[/p][p]●       You can now view the enemy exhaust/discard pile.[/p][p]●       Battle cards are now smaller on handheld devices, allowing more of the map to be visible[/p][p]●       We fixed the AI getting stuck for a long time when trying to place a Deployable type of object[/p][p]●       We removed a hidden mana cost penalty for the AI playing the first card in a turn[/p][p]●       The hat shop will no longer spawn in segment 1 of a run, since no one ever has enough gold to buy anything at that point.[/p][p]●       The “impossible-without-bombs” card rush maps have been edited to… well… not be impossible…[/p][p]●       Some Trinket Route modifier issues should be resolved, allowing them to correctly apply every time.[/p][p]●       Smoke Bomb card effect reduced to 1 turn[/p][p]●       AI no longer has access to barricade track cards[/p][p]●       AI no longer has access to the Build-A-Mine card, which was causing softlock issues[/p][p]●       Trinkets that give a healing buff on win should now have a visible effect[/p][p]●       Trinkets that give a random chance for extra mana have had their seed fixed.[/p][p]●       Edited the icon for the Power of Love buff[/p][p]●       For our Steam Deck players - external controllers on the Steam Deck should now properly handle secondary controller inputs[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for being part of the Battle Train Community. We’re continuing to add to the game and are happy to see such enthusiastic players! If you’d like to chat with others about Battle Train or be able to talk things over with the Devs directly, feel free to join us on Discord! [/p][p][url="http://discord.terribleposture.com/"]http://discord.terribleposture.com/[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]The TPG Crew[/p]

notes.title: We have NEWS!!!
notes.content:
We are incredibly thrilled to finally be able to let you in on the latest Battle Train News!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45066558/15afb8ff78a31b3d413305bbb96629d851006f44.png[/img]


While we initially set out to self-publish Battle Train, our goal is to make the best game possible. We've had many opportunities cross our paths, and one such opportunity felt too good to pass up. That said, we're proud to announce that we’re now working with Bandai Namco Entertainment America Inc. to bring Battle Train to more folks in a couple of exciting ways. 

You’ve probably heard of Bandai Namco Entertainment. They’ve been around about as long as our entire industry and are known as the publishers behind everything from PAC-MAN™ to Elden Ring™ to Katamari Damacy™ (AKA, the silliest game with the best game soundtrack ever made).

Look, we know Battle Train is good.  Our friends and family know Battle Train is good.  But getting word to the general gaming community has been an uphill battle for us, so having Bandai Namco Entertainment on board to help increase our visibility is awesome… but while marketing is crucial, this news is about more than just marketing.

With Bandai Namco Entertainment’s support, we were able to extend development and add more to the game, polish the heck out of it, and really make this game sing. We’re really pleased with the results.  We’ve added extra cards, extra trains, extra trinkets, and extra time making sure Battle Train is an amazing gaming experience.

ALSO, we’re not just releasing on PC!!!  We’ll be bringing the ludicrous action of Battle Train to the Nintendo Switch™ as well!  Surprise!!! 

Now, for those of you who have been waiting to get your hands on the game, we also have a release date to announce! Battle Train will be available for purchase on June 18th. 

You can check out Bandai Namco Entertainment America Inc.’s official write-up about this news here: 
https://www.bandainamcoent.com/games/battle-train


Thank you for your support.  Thank you for your patience.  And, as always, thank you for being part of the Terrible Posture Games community.
 
The TPG Dev Team

notes.title: Turn Based Carnival: Mori Carta
notes.content:
Battle Train is part of the Turn Based Carnival going on right now here on Steam.  One of the other games you'll find there is Mori Carta, which is a unique take on a deck-based card game.

From the Dev:
[i]Mori Carta is the first "Handless" deckbuilding roguelike. Each of over 1000 cards represents a dynamic decision. Learning how to build and play 5 archetypes against over 185 uniquely challenging enemies will brutally test your skills. Join powerful companions into your strategy after first aiding them in their poetic and epic journeys. 

Try our free discoverably deep [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1570830/Mori_Carta/]demo [/url]on Steam![/i]

When I tried it out, I was honestly intrigued by how the encounters work.  Your own deck contains cards that represent the situation you're dealing with and the skills you bring to bear, and each card has an option to be played to the left or right, with different energy costs and different impacts based on where you play the card.  For instance, for an ability card, you could play it to the left to expend some energy and deal damage, or you can play it to the right and gain energy while upgrading the card, so that when the card gets shuffled back into your deck it will be more powerful.  Each encounter becomes a puzzle on how best to manage the deck you have, choosing which cards to expend energy for, which cards to upgrade, and where you can afford to accept the negative consequences for a card.

Fans of table top card games will find the mechanic easy to grasp and fun to play.  If you give it a try, let us know what you think!

notes.title: Prepare for the Party Apocalypse: Rogue Piñatas is Coming to SteamVR!
notes.content:
[b]Rogue-like you’ve NEVER seen before, a new VR game by Nerd Ninjas![/b]
We’re thrilled to officially pull back the curtain on our latest VR game, [url=https://roguepinatas.com/]Rogue Piñatas: VRmageddon[/url], which will be making its grand debut at Steam Next Fest today! After substantial development efforts, we’re finally sharing the full details of our candy-packed game. Starting today, you can download and play the demo for Rogue Piñatas as part of the Next Fest lineup, giving you a first-hand experience of the colorful, explosive world we’ve crafted.

[b]A Multiplayer VR Roguelite Game. [/b]
No one suspected the piñatas—but after a birthday party goes haywire, the world now faces an onslaught of endless swarms of angry piñatas! As the last line of defense, you are humanity’s final hope in the VRmageddon. The mission is simple: survive the party apocalypse or succumb to sweet defeat!

Every run puts your skills to the test as you battle through unique enemies, tackle formidable boss fights, and navigate ravaged environments. Bash, dodge, shoot, and explore your way through waves of piñatas, collecting candy and powerful meta-progression upgrades along the way. With a vast arsenal of weapons, abilities, and power-ups to discover, no two runs are ever the same. Are you ready to face the wildest, most chaotic birthday party of your life?

Wishlist on Steam: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2700990/Rogue_Piatas_VRmageddon/]HERE[/url]
Try the demo: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2700990/Rogue_Piatas_VRmageddon/]HERE[/url]

[b]Try the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2700990/Rogue_Piatas_VRmageddon/]First-Ever Demo[/url] at Steam Next Fest![/b]
Nerd Ninjas is proud to be participating in the Steam Next Fest for a week-long celebration for upcoming games! So if you're piñata-curious, now's your chance to get your hands on Rogue Piñatas! The demo is live right now as part of Steam Next Fest. Download it, jump in, and start smashing your way through colorful enemies, gaining powerful upgrades, uncovering hidden power-ups, and putting your skills to the test against some of our game’s bosses.

The demo is just a taste of what’s to come–there’s much MORE in the full game that we can’t wait to share, from additional piñatas and levels, to special weapons and new modes. Your feedback during this event is critical to helping us fine-tune and perfect the game before its full release.

notes.title: Let's Get Ready to Play Some Battle Train!!!
notes.content:
[b]Terrible Posture Games and Nerd Ninjas join forces to build the world's most ridiculous dueling train game BATTLE TRAIN![/b]


Terrible Posture Games, developers of indie gems Tower of Guns, Mothergunship, and the wacky playable sitcom ‘3 out of 10’ are excited to announce Battle Train!


Developed in collaboration with video game developer and publisher Nerd Ninjas (known to kick it with industry leaders Meta and Niantic), BATTLE TRAIN is the “World’s FIRST Explosive Dueling Locomotive Deck-n-Track Builder Played Over the Backdrop of a Game Show” (we think)!


Outfit your train, lay down tracks to your enemy's base, and obliterate them with dynamite, natural disasters, and mildly harsh (but still all-ages appropriate) language!


Get to know the colorful cast and crew behind the world's most popular game show–Battle Train–as you fight through the ranks of champions in this wildly over the top deck-'n'-track builder.


Compete for the big bucks, the title of Supreme President Conductor and, of course, the chance to win a complimentary copy of "Battle Train: The Home Edition!"



[i]About Terrible Posture Games:[/i]
Terrible Posture Games is a developer with a penchant for fresh ideas in gaming. Founded by industry veteran Joe Mirabello, in 2014 we released Tower of Guns, one of the earliest FPS roguelite hybrids. Since then, we’ve co-developed MOTHERGUNSHIP, released two seasons of the unique playable sitcom 3 out of 10, worked on popular brands such as The Walking Dead and Invincible, and built the highly regarded VR exclusive MOTHERGUNSHIP: FORGE. Find out more at: https://www.terribleposture.com/


[i]About Nerd Ninjas:[/i]
Nerd Ninjas is an indie gaming studio of digital mercenaries, known for its innovative approach to AR/VR, desktop and mobile platforms. With a focus on pushing boundaries of creativity and technology, Nerd Ninjas is masterfully trained in the electric arts and has the combined nerd experience of publishing over 20+ games, many which have been ranked within the Top 10 of Apple’s App Store. Find out more at: https://nerdninjas.com/
